PLAIN-LANGUAGE PRIVACY

Your beta data stays on your device.

Glow Getters’s public beta does not require an account and does not send your plans, habits, reflections, recordings, or uploaded images to a shared Glow Getters database.

What is stored

Your entries and preferences are saved in this browser’s local storage. They can be available when you return using the same browser and device.

What is not shared

Profile, follower, Explore, and public-sharing screens are product previews. Choosing “Public” does not publish your personal content to other users in this beta.

What you should know

Clearing browser data, using private browsing, or changing devices can remove your entries. Do not use this beta for passwords, payment information, medical records, emergency information, or other highly sensitive data.
